name: create-contact
description: Creates a HubSpot contact from an email address, with optional name, phone, company, job title and owner (an id from hubspot__list-owners), and optionally associates it with a company (a company id from hubspot__get-record).

ownerId.description: A HubSpot owner ID from hubspot__list-owners.

companyId.description: A company id to associate the contact with, from the associations hubspot__get-record answers.
